# Vendored QR libraries

- qrcode-generator 1.4.4, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- qr-scanner 1.4.2, Nimiq, MIT: https://github.com/nimiq/qr-scanner

Pinned npm distributions downloaded via jsDelivr during development. All files are served locally; no runtime CDN requests. Keep versions and licenses together when updating. Upstream source-map files are not deployed.
